reason: Kept for compatibility: the two-argument call still sends { status } alone, which updateTestOrderStatus does not allow (lines is required); the SDK docs and README now steer to the three-argument form with options.lines.

Spec spells it `Offset` here (and `offset` on the other lists). Hepsiburada SIT, 2026-10-14: GET /packages/merchantid/{id}?limit=1 with offset=1 and with Offset=1 returned the same second package, so the query name is case-insensitive.

Spec spells it `Offset` here (and `offset` on the other lists). Hepsiburada SIT, 2026-10-14: GET /packages/merchantid/{id}?limit=1 with offset=1 and with Offset=1 returned the same second package, so the query name is case-insensitive.

The SDK sends `{}` (the input defaults to an empty object); Hepsiburada SIT, 2026-10-14, took it past validation to the package lookup (500 DeliveryNotFound on a stub package), so the empty body is harmless.
